title: The Efficacy and Safety of Using the Novel Tyto Device
brief_summary: To investigate the efficacy and safety of using the novel Tyto device for remote physical examination by co-investigators as compared to a standard medical physical examination by physicians.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who present to the Emergency department and are categorized between 2-5 on the Canadian Triage \& Acuity Scale (CTAS) scoring scale.

Exclusion Criteria:

* CTAS 1.
* Pregnant adolescent.
* Multi-drug resistant carriers.
* Intellectual disability disorders.
* Unsigned informed consent.

  * Patients with CTAS score of 2-3, will be first addressed by a physician to ascertain their eligibility to be enrolled to the study.
